wiki_only_topics.topic: Etymology of the term Abyssinia from Egyptian hieroglyphs and South Arabian inscriptions.
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: The origin of the term might be found in Egyptian hieroglyphic as the designation of a southern region near the Red Sea that produced incense, known as ḫbś.tj.w, "the bearded ones" (i.e Punt). wiki_only_topics.topic: Ottoman province of Habesh and Özdemir Pasha's conquest of Massawa and Arqiqo.
